svg.title: Horn-gear track of a 16-carrier regular (2/2) braider
svg.desc: Computed from the machine model: 8 horn gears and the serpentine paths of the two carrier families, shown at an instant when every '+' carrier passes a '−' carrier. The two carriers of a passing are on opposite arcs of their gear; the outer carrier's yarn goes over.
